title: Verify review-lens v2 migration (already committed)
goal: Confirm the review-lens plugin migration to contract v2 is complete and all acceptance-criteria tests pass, fixing any remaining gaps discovered during verification.

steps.description: Run the full test suite to establish which SPEC-1–SPEC-19 assertions pass and which fail. This is the gating step: every subsequent step is contingent on what this step reveals. Expected outcome: all tests green. If any SPEC fails, the failing assertion pinpoints the gap to fix in subsequent steps.

If SPEC-4 (schema-gate recovery) or SPEC-2/_review_lens_envelope_schema_ok fails: verify that `_llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok` appears at the rc=0 parse site in plugin.sh (currently line 330) and that _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok validates `.findings | type == "array"`. Fix if absent or incorrect.

If SPEC-1/SPEC-2/SPEC-3/SPEC-13/SPEC-15 fail: verify _review_lens_write_result writes {result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason} and is called on every terminal exit path (router failure, unparseable reply, normalization failure, rc=130, rc=10). Ensure rc=10 branch propagates rc=10 and writes disposition:exhausted, and rc=130 branch propagates rc=130 and writes disposition:interrupted. Fix any missing or mis-wired branch.

If SPEC-5/SPEC-6/SPEC-14 fail: verify _review_lens_budget_guidance and _review_lens_wallclock_guidance are called with values from _route_resolve_max_turns and _route_resolve_timeout respectively, and their output is appended to the prompt before the route_to_model call. Fix sourcing or call-site if broken.

If SPEC-7/SPEC-12/SPEC-16/SPEC-17/SPEC-18/SPEC-19 fail: verify manifest.yaml has result_contract:2, valid_verdicts (complete+degraded), primary:true on lens_result output, provides.events (exactly three), provides.role:review_lens, inputs with only id+required (no path/type/producer_stage), and hooks.cleanup absent with ADR-054 §7 comment. Apply any missing manifest fields.

Confirm two grep acceptance criteria: (a) _review_lens_write_result body contains no quoted literal artifact filenames (no 'lens-*.json' or 'scope-manifest.md' string literals — SPEC-11); (b) no merge-action coercion tokens (approve|request_changes|"block") appear in plugin.sh or lib/charters.sh (SPEC-9/SPEC-10). Fix any violation found.

Run `npm test` a final time to confirm all SPEC-1–SPEC-19 assertions are green. This satisfies the DoD 'npm test green' and 'reddens at merge-base' (the test file contains assertions that would have failed before migration) requirements.

notes: Current branch (zbuild/issue-1840-ci) already has commits titled 'Migrate review-lens to contract v2 with schema-gate, budget guidance, and rc=10 exhausted disposition'. Inspection of manifest.yaml and plugin.sh shows all v2 contract fields appear present: result_contract:2, valid_verdicts, provides.role, provides.events, primary:true, router knobs in config, name-matched inputs (id+required only), cleanup absent with ADR-054 §7 comment, _review_lens_write_result on all exit paths, _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok schema gate, _llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate call, rc=10 exhausted branch, rc=130 interrupted branch, budget guidance injected from _route_resolve_max_turns/_route_resolve_timeout. The test file contains SPEC-1 through SPEC-19 covering all acceptance criteria. The plan is therefore primarily a verification plan — each implementation step is only executed if the corresponding SPEC fails. The 'before/after golden diff' acceptance criterion is addressed by SPEC-8 in the test file (guards that advisory degrade behavior is unchanged); no separate golden file exists in tests/golden/ for review-lens. The 'reddens at merge-base' criterion is satisfied structurally: the SPEC-1–SPEC-19 tests assert v2 fields that would be absent on the pre-migration codebase. Estimated_lines is low because no new code is expected to be needed; the budget exists only for gap-filling discovered in step-1.
